code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. `Group.NotFound`, `ApiKey.Expired`, `Validation.Failed`. Branch on this, never on `title`.

timestamp.description: When the event happened on the client (ISO-8601, UTC).

playerId.description: Client-chosen stable player id (process-mining case id): 1-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -

id.description:
Client-generated UUID (v7 recommended) - the idempotency key. Optional: when omitted
the server generates one, but retries of that request are then not deduplicated.

group.description:
Optional group slug of the player in this scenario. The first group recorded for a player wins; a conflicting
one is ignored.

eventData.description: Arbitrary JSON payload; bare strings are auto-cured to JSON.

duplicates.description: Events whose id was already stored (idempotent retries) - counted, not errors.

groupErrors.description:
Groups that could not be assigned (`Group.NotFound` when the app forbids unknown groups, `Group.LimitReached` at the
per-scenario cap). Their events are stored without a group; stop sending that group.

rejected.description: Events dropped for a reason that retrying will not fix (`EventLog.TimestampInFuture`: client clock too far ahead).

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. `Group.NotFound`, `ApiKey.Expired`, `Validation.Failed`. Branch on this, never on `title`.

ApiKey.description: Publishable per-game-app anon key from the dashboard. Safe to ship in the game build; keys always expire.
